Name: Shammai, Son of Ezra
Summary: Son borne in Ezra's line, named beside Miriam and Ishbah.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 4:17: Son borne in Ezra's line, named beside Miriam and Ishbah.
LifeLesson: The mention of Shammai in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
